description: This file provides core game logic functions for a Wordle-like game, including evaluating guesses against a target word, selecting a target word based on daily or random modes, and determining keyboard precedence for game UI feedback.

methods.name: evaluateGuess
methods.description: Evaluates a user's guess against the target word and returns an array of TileState indicating per-letter correctness (correct, present, absent). Implements a two-pass approach to handle multiple occurrences of the same letter.

methods.name: selectTargetWord
methods.description: Selects a target word either based on the current date for daily challenges or randomly from a list of candidates. Ensures the chosen word is in uppercase.

methods.name: keyboardPrecedence
methods.description: Assigns a precedence value to each TileState to determine visual priority, with correct being the highest.
